findings.source_quote: There have been several studies that compared exercise to antidepressants and found that it had similar effectiveness to many of the commonly prescribed antidepressant medications.
findings.suggested_fix: The translation uses the nonstandard compound "effektiewydheid". Replace with a clear Afrikaans equivalent such as "soortgelyke doeltreffendheid" or "vergelykbare effektiwiteit" while preserving meaning. Example fix: "Daar is verskeie studies wat oefening met antidepressante vergelyk het en bevind het dat dit ’n soortgelyke doeltreffendheid het as baie van die algemeen voorgeskrewe antidepressante medikasie."
